profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Intuit | Front End Development
profile.summary:
At Intuit, my focus has been on crafting user-friendly interfaces and contributing to the seamless functionality of web applications. My proficiency with ReactJS and TypeScript has enabled me to build and enhance dynamic, responsive front-end systems that drive user engagement and satisfaction. 

At the core of my approach is a commitment to collaborative problem-solving and meticulous code quality. My role in developing application at KSquare Solutions Inc. honed my skills, fortifying my expertise in creating solutions that serve both the technical and user community effectively.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Design and develop from scratch a developer site to share or join in challenges or hackathons: tech Dojo as a MEAN App (AngularJS, NodeJS &MongoDB), creating all design, add style and functionality.

- Worked on the BigHalf project, a realtime data analytics application and platform written in AngularJS.

- Designed, prototyped, and built out UI of the BigHalf using HTML5, LESS CSS and AngularJS

- Develop some modules with AngularJS for web application BigHalf.io like Notifications, groups and others with nodeJS and Cassandra integration.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.locationName: Av. Eugenio Garza Sada , Aguascalientes, Aguascalientes.
positions.description:
- Working on a big web application for GE, Colab is a web application project as a business social network in where users interact with partners in order to organize, contact and work online. 

- Developed and support new features on a GE web application with 300,000+ users and add Google Analytics to verify site metrics.

- Follow a SCRUM methodology in order to keep all the stakeholders aligned and in compliance with the project goals.

- Structure code as web components or modules to expedite changes and new features in order to find quickly templates, controllers, style or specific part of code.

- Implemented request to a RestFul services with AJAX in order to make a dynamic application.

- Modularize old code in order to use requireJS.

- Used backboneJS to create new features and support actual.

- Implemented a time line in where exist variable activity as likes, posts or news in where for each exist a post details or a user lists.

- Create all new modules for contacts, followers an followings, using infinite scroll.

- Supported and created new services on a RestFul API with nodeJS and mongoDB.

- Added some unit testing with Karma, jasmine and PhantomJS in order reduced the amount of bugs found at Stage or even Production environment.

- Responsible for a site module (Profile) to fix all the issues.

- Created specific plugins for rich text editor (TinyMCE) in order to add hashtags, mentions, code, etc.

- Cross-browsing support for old browsers.

- Used handlebarsJS and EJS to build semantic templates in order to separate as template and make it own controller in where all functionality is developed.

- Structure databases and services.

- Developed widgets to communicate with twitter and facebook APIs.

- Planned and started app migration, BackboneJS to AngularJS.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Laguna seca 203, Las Lagunas, Villa de Alvarez, Colima.
positions.description:
- Presidencia2012.com was a web magazine develop with a CSM with javascript and PHP.

- Developed a news site with a CMS (Joomla).

- Created plugins and new Joomla modules.

- Designed and coded the User Interface of the website using JavaScript and PHP. 

- Developed dynamic magazine with Phonegap to Android and iOS.

- Planned and designed animations and responsive design for mobile magazine.

- Created dynamic magazine with javascript, HTML5 and CSS3.

- Developed widgets to communicate with twitter and Facebook APIs.

- Used jQuery plugins to implement features as a light box, sliders and other intuitive features. 

- Implement a module for History editions for a post with possibilities to go back to previous versions or edit new ones with AJAX and use mySQL to store the history.

- Worked in scrum process attending daily stand up and completing tasks in sprints.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
- Siabuc is a desktop software created to administrate all the common process used in big libraries and providing solutions related with Microsoft environment.

- Developed new modules for a library software desktop SIABUC used in Mexico and a lot of south american countries.

- Make a migration from VB6 to VB.NET.

- Created patchs to run the application on early windows versions.
